_file_note: Notes for app/data/model/world_facts.json: where each field came from, who writes and reads it, and the rules it must obey. The field's type, allowed answers, required-ness and column type live with the class in app/models/. Merged by app/repositories/model_catalogue_repository.py.
about: Curated South African everyday costs (fuel, data, taxi, grants) agents reason against so they never invent a magnitude.
rules: Every fact has a numeric value and a unit, so it can be checked with the model off.
Each item appears once; provenance decides which wins if two sources disagree (curated > discovered > web).
